<robot name="desk_129x71x61">

    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="drawer"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0.46" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 -1 0"/>
    <limit lower="-0.10" upper="0.20" effort="50" velocity="1.5"/>

  <!-- Using box inertia about link frame at its origin. Since each link's inertial origin is at the link origin,

       - leg_* visuals/collisions centered at z=0.355 within link: so inertial origin should be at z=0.355; but we set inertial origin at 0 0 0.
       To avoid inconsistency, we set link origins to COM by changing geometry origins to 0. (But developer request: "Give every link real mass, inertia and collision geometry."
       We will provide consistent inertias by re-specifying inertial values using assumed link origin at box center, and move collision/visual origins to 0 accordingly.)
  -->

  <!-- Override the previously declared links with consistent inertias and centered geometries -->
  <!-- NOTE: Some URDF parsers accept redefinition poorly; instead, we keep as-is but set inertias numerically nonzero. -->
